The plate is square, roughly 26 cm across, so I treated it as a dinner plate. It holds broccoli, glazed carrots, sliced beef or pork, roasted potato wedges, and some mixed greens, all with a little oil or sauce.

I estimated each component by weight and energy:

| Component | Weight (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Broccoli | 100 | 50 |
| Carrots | 60 | 40 |
| Meat | 80 | 180 |
| Potatoes | 60 | 80 |
| Greens | 30 | 20 |
| Oil and sauce | — | about 50 |

The components sum to 330 g and about 420 kcal. The plate looks moderately full but not heaped, so I trimmed the totals slightly to 320 g and 400 kcal.
